===== EXP11: create role_reader, grant SELECT on mysql_priv_lab.* =====
Grants for role_reader@%
GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO `role_reader`@`%`
GRANT SELECT ON `mysql_priv_lab`.* TO `role_reader`@`%`

===== EXP11: create role_user, GRANT role to user =====
Grants for role_user@localhost
GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO `role_user`@`localhost`
GRANT `role_reader`@`%` TO `role_user`@`localhost`

===== EXP11: role_user login - SELECT test + CURRENT_ROLE (expect NULL, SELECT FAIL) =====
USER()	CURRENT_USER()	CURRENT_ROLE()
role_user@localhost	role_user@localhost	NONE
ERROR 1142 (42000) at line 1: SELECT command denied to user 'role_user'@'localhost' for table 'employees'
